definitions.explanation: A female child. A formal or official word used on documents, in news, and in set phrases rather than in casual speech.

examples.japanese: {元気|げんき}な{女児|じょじ}が{生|う}まれた。
この{服|ふく}は{女児|じょじ}{用|よう}です。
{事故|じこ}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた{幼|おさな}い{女児|じょじ}は{無事|ぶじ}{保護|ほご}された。
examples.english: The young girl caught up in the accident was safely taken into protection.

notes:
Formal and official; common in birth announcements, product labels ({女児|じょじ}{用|よう}), and news. Everyday speech uses {女|おんな}の{子|こ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女児|じょじ}を{出産|しゅっさん}する: to give birth to a girl
- {女児|じょじ}{用|よう}: for girls (on products)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {女|おんな}の{子|こ}: girl — everyday, neutral
- {男児|だんじ}: male child — the male counterpart
